function wpbp_html_api_006( string $html ): string {
	$p = new WP_HTML_Tag_Processor( $html );
	$in_figure = false;
	$figcaption_text = null;
	$img_bookmark = null;
	$figure_depth = 0;

	while ( $p->next_tag( array( 'tag_closers' => 'visit' ) ) ) {
		$tag = $p->get_tag();

		if ( 'FIGURE' === $tag && ! $p->is_tag_closer() ) {
			$figure_depth++;
			if ( 1 === $figure_depth ) {
				$in_figure = true;
				$figcaption_text = null;
				$img_bookmark = null;
			}
			continue;
		}

		if ( 'FIGURE' === $tag && $p->is_tag_closer() ) {
			$figure_depth--;
			if ( 0 === $figure_depth && $in_figure ) {
				if ( null !== $figcaption_text && null !== $img_bookmark ) {
					if ( $p->seek( $img_bookmark ) ) {
						if ( ! $p->get_attribute( 'alt' ) && ! $p->has_attribute( 'alt' ) ) {
							$p->set_attribute( 'alt', $figcaption_text );
						}
						$p->seek( 'figure_end_' . $figure_depth );
					}
				}
				$in_figure = false;
				$figcaption_text = null;
				$img_bookmark = null;
			}
			continue;
		}

		if ( ! $in_figure || 1 !== $figure_depth ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( 'FIGCAPTION' === $tag && ! $p->is_tag_closer() ) {
			$figcaption_text = trim( $p->get_modifiable_text() );
			continue;
		}

		if ( 'IMG' === $tag && ! $p->is_tag_closer() ) {
			if ( $p->has_attribute( 'alt' ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( null === $img_bookmark ) {
				$img_bookmark = 'img_' . uniqid();
				$p->set_bookmark( $img_bookmark );
			}
			continue;
		}
	}

	return $p->get_updated_html();
}
